title: Round 6 stream A: K0-TECH, the third companion, and the Nih-Dairia mech, Isao's own pet after THE ARENA, posed by the workshop's runtime ported
context: Owner, 2026-11-05, note 1 (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-05-round-6-five-notes-design.md, stream A): K0-TECH is the small feline (https://jelaludo.github.io/SentryTowers_A6/k0-tech-01/), and after the Nih-Dairia fight Isao prints himself a Nih-Dairia mech about the tank's size, as he does the other pets. Both assets were already downloaded and hash-checked; upstream SentryTowers_A6 at cd0b1349 serves the same bytes (verified by sha256 for the four GLBs and runtime.js). The companions host, the play rule and the print were written for two units (units[1 - i], for i < 2).
outcome: 1a (commit 79442ffd): unit `k0` K0-TECH (assets/models/k0-tech LOD1 + LOD2 + README; docs/companions-assets.lock.json extended with a per-entry baseUrl at cd0b1349, scripts/assets.mjs reads it first). Gaits stalk 0.0893 / walk 0.2383 / gallop 2.6889 m/s, its own wander band [0.2, 0.34] on its walk, Pounce a trick in place (1.6 m root travel), born pet_born_k0. Third in COMPANIONS.prints.order: perk farm (the greenhouse, sector 3) + 2 days after the dog, delay 10, patience 150, pet_print_third. The play runs over a list: tag is a game of two among the printed ones (game.pair, a record's `with`, the scene's 'other' resolves to it). Bestiary entry (colony, K0-TECH / LYNX-POINT SIAMESE), director pet:2, DAY 42's close shot at units[].shotScale 0.5, the diorama's third place. 1b: unit `mech` (assets/models/nih-dairia-mech LOD1 + LOD2 + README + runtime.js unchanged, pinned with clips []). runtime.js ported as src/domain/mech-pose.js (pure, its numbers in the unit's `rig`), written onto the bones by src/fx/mech-pose.js: Observation_Idle at rest, Tripod_Walk_Cycle on its own phase clock at speed / 0.30 m/s capped at rig.rateCap 3 (top 0.9 m/s), held at rate 0 for 0.4 s after a stop, Anchor_Deploy as its sit, Reach_Cycle its trick, 0.6 s eased between motions (runtime.js has no transitions). Its play is `kind: 'heavy'` (src/domain/companion-play.js stepHeavy): rests 5-11 s, walks within its band, anchors or reaches, walks to a hull still 3 s and anchors 15 m off (centres), never tags, dodges, flees or dances (it watches DAY 42); the pets keep its pad 4 m + 0.6 m off it (fx heavyIn); it turns on a 10 m radius. Print: trigger `boss`, the arena's SECURE with its mother dead recorded by src/fx/sector-run.js (bossDown, kept for the run, in state().sector.bossDown); the arena's hold on prints lifts then; a unit's own `print` over the default (printKnobs): spot 3 hops out, a 9.2 m plot (bedM 4.6, a radius), refLength 7.6, hover 3.2, timeline 1.6 / 20 / 2 / 4 (27.6 s), four angles of its own; a posed unit's ghost posed too. Bestiary (ISAO FIELDWORK / BIOMIMETIC SERIES 001), director pet:3 (the board puts a boss trigger at THE ARENA's column, tag 'after the kill'), the diorama's fourth place (in frame: NDC 0.46,-0.16 / 0.64,-0.22), pet_print_mech / pet_born_mech. ATTRIBUTIONS.md and docs/ASSETS.md: one 'Models by jelaludo' section for C-07, RECKON K9, K0-TECH-01, the mech (creature reference kai-denrei/lab-creatures), FEIDS-26 and MX-06. td-tab untouched (5,357 lines). K0-TECH's top 4.2 m/s and accel 14 (over the design's 3.2 and 7) land in the 1b commit, found by its browser pass. Open: the mech has no turn solve (runtime.js has none either), so a turn slides its stance feet (10 m radius, 0.02 rad/s floor: about 0.1 m/s of slide at 0.9 m/s); the hull drives through the mech (it is an obstacle for the pets only); the pets walk at ground height under a raised slab's top (pre-existing, the 0.41 m cat shows it most); the carcass and the printed mech are 214 hops apart, never in one frame; the mech's natural print waits behind the earlier three (strictly in order), so --arena-carcass forces it; K0's faster dodge is held by the node replay, the passing --companions run drove at K9.
alternatives: The design's K0-TECH top 3.2 m/s and accel 7: overturned. In --companions' dodge drive the hull went 8 -> 27 m/s over 20 m and passed 0.82 m from the cat (round 4's rule asks 2.5 m). A scratch replay of that case (cat 22 m off, hull at 27 m/s): 3.2 / 7 closest 1.93 m, 4.2 / 14 closest 2.84 m, 5 / 20 closest 3.49 m. 4.2 m/s is as fast as its gallop plays without the paws sliding (2.6889 m/s x the 1.6 rate clamp = 4.3), so 4.2 / 14 it is; a per-unit dodge range (90 m) was tried first and changed nothing (from 100 m the 60 m range already sees a 30 m/s hull in time: 5.4-5.6 m).

The design's trigger read from boss-run's deadAt: replaced by sector-run's record of the arena's SECURE (bossLeft 0, the same frame boss-run's dead() fires). Pet-print already holds sectorRun, so no td-tab line (its bytes only go down this round).

The design's keepFromHull 6 for the mech: read as a gap. The hull's point is the centre of a 10 m hull and the mech is 7.6 m long, so centres 6 m apart overlap; keepFromHull 12 and the greet's stop 15 m (centres).

The design's per-unit bedM 9: bedM is the plot's radius in the print (the cheetah's 1.9), so the mech's is 4.6 (a 9.2 m plot); the angles had to be the mech's own (its scene is 27.6 s, the default's 15.5 s, and the default angles scaled up would look at Isao 22 m over his real height).
The mech left out of the diorama: not needed, its place at side 1.7 / front -0.5 lands in frame at both ends of the rail.
The cat on the hull's deck in the diorama: not done, a third place on the ground in front of the hull's camera-side corner instead (needs no hull geometry).
